fields.statement: Verifier at 609344f55. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipLand: ok; TestShipLandNodeChangedMergesMain asserts an exit-3 'cannot land change set X: node N changed' head-build failure returns a conflict naming node N and the conflicted file, with the merge conflict recorded; TestShipLandOtherHeadFailureStaysPlain asserts another exit-3 message and an exit-1 keep the head build's detail, merge nothing and record no conflict (TestShipLandHeadBuildErrorDetail also passes). go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/...: ok (land-conflict-triage on.fail -> land-main-conflict-triage, which passes to conflict-fix only). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-land-conflict fails at this commit at build/check ('Evidence ... written by claude-code-..., who wrote its commit'), as does the untouched run-ship-model-conflict script: a base regression from d38f497d2 (shared actor handle), not this leaf. With 609344f55 cherry-picked onto d38f497d2^ in a scratch worktree, run-ship-land-conflict passes: case 1 goes land fail -> land-triage -> land-conflict-triage -> land-main-conflict-triage pass -> conflict-fix -> render-pr -> land visit 2 pass, never conflict-fix-landed; case 2 (other exit-3 message) fails the run at land-main-conflict-triage with no fixer. Diff read: shipLandNodeChanged requires exit status 3, no structured model conflict, and the node-changed message.
